text: At most one HELD or CONFIRMED reservation owns a slot; competing requests receive one success and explicit conflicts.
criteria: Release 20 concurrent hold requests for the same slot: exactly one live reservation/allocation pair.

text: A hold lasts five minutes and can be confirmed only before expiry; a replay returns the original reservation.
criteria: Confirm at 08:04:59, then in an isolated reset at 08:05:00; accept only the first. Replayed confirmation has no extra effect.

text: Cancellation or expiry releases a slot at most once and cannot release a newer reservation's allocation.
criteria: Cancel/rebook, then deliver the old hold's expiry event; the new reservation retains the slot.
Interrupt an expiry run and resume; expired holds are released once, while confirmed bookings stay allocated.

text: Students access only their reservations; staff may close only a currently unallocated slot.
criteria: Another student cannot confirm/cancel the winner; closing an allocated slot conflicts instead of silently evicting them.

text: List available slots by room/day with documented freshness; attempt-to-book remains authoritative.
criteria: Query advisory availability, let another user win, then book from the stale view; return conflict and preserve the invariant.

text: With 20 simultaneous contenders for one slot, preserve RS-R1 and meet the shared metadata target for ordinary non-contentious reads.
criteria: Release 20 concurrent hold requests for the same slot: exactly one live reservation/allocation pair.
